title: Auto Collect Auto Sell
features:
automatically collects the stack. also sells the stacj.
note: this script requires you to not unequip the stack. the only way to sell is by having it equipped, which this script automatically does.
open sourced, keyless, op.
script:
setclipboard("https://discord.gg/TR3quUFgT6")

local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local conduit = rs:WaitForChild("Modules")
	:WaitForChild("Internals")
	:WaitForChild("Skeleton")
	:WaitForChild("Conduit")
	:WaitForChild("Instances")

local collect = conduit:WaitForChild("_collectEarnings")
local sell = conduit:WaitForChild("_sellStack")

local args = {
	{
		__raw = true,
		data = {}
	}
}

local function equipAllTools()
	local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

	for _, tool in ipairs(player.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
		if tool:IsA("Tool") then
			humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
		end
	end
end

while true do
	collect:FireServer(unpack(args))
	sell:FireServer(unpack(args))
	equipAllTools()
	task.wait(4.5)
end
